surfaces.label: Local E2E server and child-process orchestration
surfaces.notes: The test-only server binds to loopback, Playwright is launched without a shell through a pinned local path, its exit code is preserved, and the Vite server closes in a finally block. No production import or runtime path references this harness.
surfaces.riskArea: Command injection, unintended network exposure, process leaks, and false-success test results
